# Probability & Statistics

Move from statistical thinking and exploratory analysis through probability,
distributions, sampling-based inference, Bayesian decisions, and advanced
regression models.

::: {.topic-lesson-grid}
::: {.topic-lesson-card}
### [Statistics and Probability for Data Science](../statistics-and-probability-for-data-science/index.Rmd)

Twenty-five lessons covering statistical thinking, exploratory data analysis,
probability rules, Bayes' theorem and naïve Bayes, random variables, discrete
and continuous distributions, the central limit theorem, confidence
intervals, and maximum likelihood estimation.
